title: Recheck the Engram reader under the final evaluator installation lock
outcome: If the project switches its Engram reader after the last off-lock acceptance check while keeping the same established store, the request refuses to install its evaluator under the stale reader.
acceptance: A behavioural test changes the reader configuration while preserving the established store at the final installation boundary and shows that the request refuses without installing an evaluator.
The same request installs normally when the original reader is still current at installation.
